subject.title: fix: default TLS gateway deep links to port 443 when port is omitted

question: Should omitted-port TLS openclaw://gateway links switch from 18789 to 443 now, while explicit port values remain preserved?
rationale: The change aligns gateway deep links with setup-code and raw URL parsing, but it intentionally changes the fallback for existing omitted-port TLS links.

options.title: Accept 443 parity in this focused PR
options.body: Merge this focused PR after required checks are green or classified, accepting that omitted-port TLS gateway links now resolve to the standard TLS port 443.

options.title: Use the broader batch instead
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100258 is chosen as the landing path, verify it preserves the same iOS behavior and close this PR as superseded only after that path is safe.

options.title: Preserve the old fallback
options.body: Hold or revise the PR if compatibility with omitted-port TLS links that implicitly meant 18789 is more important than parser parity.

recommendation.title: Accept 443 parity in this focused PR
recommendation.body: Merge this focused PR after required checks are green or classified, accepting that omitted-port TLS gateway links now resolve to the standard TLS port 443.
